hooks.command: if command -v manuwright >/dev/null 2>&1; then manuwright hook session --plugin-root "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; else echo "manuwright CLI not found: install it (see README) - workflow hooks are OFF" >&2; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if (Get-Command manuwright -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { manuwright hook session --plugin-root "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" } else { Write-Error "manuwright CLI not found - workflow hooks are OFF" }
